historical_typed_affine_open_boundary_se.reused_fact: Exact affine-coset support bundles may be carried as a GF(2) linear system and existentially projected to a live boundary by Gaussian elimination; non-affine OR3 remains unresolved/open.

sealed_interface_quotient.reused_fact: GF(2) rank/rowspace operations and strict factor-through adequacy are polynomial; affine syndrome applicability is scoped rather than universal.

anti_loop.new_successor_obligation: Derive exact affine structure directly from arbitrary-size explicit raw relation tables, combine any number of affine relations in a cut component, eliminate internal variables symbolically, intersect component boundary messages by stacking equations, reconstruct a global assignment, and verify every original explicit tuple with one uniform original-L polynomial envelope.

scope: RAW_EXPLICIT_BOOLEAN_RELATION_INPUT; CANONICAL_MINCUT_PARENT_RETURNS_OPEN_MINCUT_BRANCH_BUDGET_WITH_ZERO_RAW_BRANCH_ENUMERATION; AT_LEAST_ONE_CUT_COMPONENT_HAS_THREE_OR_MORE_RELATIONS; PREDECESSOR_TWO_RELATION_GATE_RETURNS_OPEN_COMPONENT_RELATION_COUNT_GT_2; EVERY RELATION IN EVERY CUT COMPONENT MUST BE PROVEN EXACTLY AFFINE FROM ITS OWN EXPLICIT RAW ROW SET WITHOUT LABELS OR AMBIENT-CUBE ENUMERATION.

formal_mechanism.raw_affine_recognition: For relation R over scope S, deduplicate explicit rows, choose canonical first row a, form D={r xor a}. Compute GF(2) rank rho of D. R is admitted affine iff |R| = 2^rho and every listed difference is in the computed span; since D has exactly 2^rho distinct members, it equals the generated subspace. No ambient 2^|S| scan is permitted.
formal_mechanism.equation_extraction: Compute a basis for the orthogonal complement W_perp of the direction span W. Each h in W_perp yields exact equation h dot x = h dot a (mod 2). This equation system denotes exactly R.
formal_mechanism.component_system: Embed every local affine equation into the union variable set of its cut component and stack all rows, yielding A_B B + A_U U = c.
formal_mechanism.boundary_projection: Existentially eliminate U by polynomial GF(2) row operations. The projected boundary message is an affine linear system M B = d whose solutions are exactly the B assignments extendable to the component. No boundary assignment enumeration and no relational join materialization are allowed.
formal_mechanism.global_boundary_carrier: Stack every cut-component boundary equation system over the same canonical cut B. Solve the resulting GF(2) system for B or certify inconsistency.
formal_mechanism.reconstruction: If global B is consistent, backsolve internal variables independently in each original component system, merge assignments on B, then verify each original relation tuple against its explicit allowed-row set.
formal_mechanism.exactness: SAT iff the stacked boundary affine system is consistent. Boundary projection and reconstruction preserve exact existential semantics for the frozen all-affine raw relation scope.
formal_mechanism.uniformity: All recognition, nullspace/equation extraction, elimination, stacking, solve, backsolve, reconstruction and tuple verification use matrices/explicit rows whose dimensions are bounded polynomially in canonical explicit input length L; exponent is independent of relation count.

positive_control.name: K20_THREE_RELATION_NO_FULL_CUT_ANCHOR_ALL_RAW_AFFINE
positive_control.construction_rule: Reuse the v3.0 three-relation incidence scopes so canonical cut structure is unchanged, but replace every relation table by an exactly affine one- or two-row coset chosen to share one globally consistent witness.

negative_controls.construction: Replace one admitted affine raw table by an explicit 3-row OR-like relation while preserving its scope/incidence.

complexity_claim.raw_affine_recognition: Polynomial in explicit rows times arity via GF(2) elimination and cardinality comparison; no 2^arity ambient scan.
complexity_claim.component_projection: Polynomial Gaussian elimination on at most polynomially many equations and variables encoded by the input.
complexity_claim.global_boundary_solve: Polynomial GF(2) elimination on stacked boundary equations.
complexity_claim.reconstruction_verify: Polynomial backsolve plus explicit tuple membership verification.
